name: OWASP Kubernetes Top Ten
source_notes: Verified against the OWASP Kubernetes Top Ten project page and repo (index.md, 2025/en/src K01 and K03 pages).
caveats: Project page says "2025 Top 10 Risks now available Feedback welcome"; it is unclear whether 2025 is final, so status is "draft". Exact release date not confirmed.
IDs have no year suffix (K01..K10); the 2022 edition reuses the same IDs with different meanings (e.g. K02:2022 Supply Chain Vulnerabilities), so always qualify with the edition.
Only K01 and K03 detail pages were read; other items have summaries based on their names, and prevention is empty or reinhardt inference.
The notes attribute no CWEs to these items.
Kubernetes checks are lower priority for vibe-coded apps; manifest/Helm signals are reinhardt inferences.

items.name: Insecure Workload Configurations
items.summary: Workloads run with dangerous defaults or settings such as root users, default capabilities, auto-mounted service-account tokens, unconfined seccomp, no resource limits, privileged mode or host namespaces.
prevention: Run as a non-root user and group (runAsUser/runAsGroup, hostUsers: false on Kubernetes 1.33+).
Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and privileged: false.
Avoid host namespaces and set resource limits.

static: allowPrivilegeEscalation unset or true; runAsNonRoot missing
Dockerfile without USER or ending as root
review: Admission policies applied in the cluster

items.name: Overly Permissive Authorization Configurations
items.summary: Authorization (e.g. RBAC) configuration grants broader access than needed.
prevention: (inferred) Avoid wildcard RBAC verbs and resources.

items.name: Secrets Management Failures
items.summary: Secrets are exposed through images, ConfigMaps, environment variables, repositories, broad WATCH/LIST access or logs.
prevention: Use Workload Identity Federation or the External Secrets Operator.
Use the TokenRequest API for short-lived service-account tokens.

static: kind: Secret with literal data/stringData committed
Secrets in ConfigMaps or container env literals
review: etcd encryption and secret access in the cluster

items.name: Lack Of Cluster Level Policy Enforcement
items.summary: The cluster lacks centrally enforced security policies; detail page not read.

items.name: Missing Network Segmentation Controls
items.summary: Network traffic between workloads is not segmented; detail page not read.

items.name: Overly Exposed Kubernetes Components
items.summary: Kubernetes components are exposed more widely than necessary; detail page not read.

static: (inferred) Services of type LoadBalancer for internal components

items.name: Misconfigured And Vulnerable Cluster Components
items.summary: Cluster components are misconfigured or run vulnerable versions; detail page not read.

items.name: Cluster To Cloud Lateral Movement
items.summary: An attacker in the cluster can move laterally into the underlying cloud environment; detail page not read.

review: Cloud IAM bindings for workloads and node identities

items.name: Broken Authentication Mechanisms
items.summary: Authentication to the cluster is weak or broken; detail page not read.

items.name: Inadequate Logging And Monitoring
items.summary: Cluster activity is not logged or monitored adequately; detail page not read.
